_experiment.description: OBD baseline: diagonal-Hessian saliency 0.5·H_ii·w_ij², global selection, same manifold adjust step. For ReLU networks H_ii = 2·(∂d_W/∂w_i)² so OBD≡Kwon on ReLU; they diverge on tanh/sigmoid. Run via: python -m sparsifier.obd_sparsifier experiments/e13_obd.json
literature: LeCun, Denker & Solla 1989 (lecun1989optimal): Optimal Brain Damage — second-order saliency for structured pruning
